scope: Advisory plans only; root scripts/media/jobs untouched.
parser: Node specifications split at final colon only; Swedish FPA:s/UNHCR:s possessives retained.
semantic_priorities: Work-route job prerequisite does not apply to all permit grounds. Company ownership alone does not give permit; own active business and income matter.
Continuous A and temporary B are both time-limited; neither is permanent P. Archived A/B terminology remains unedited. No invented qualifying residence years.
Pending first-permit work rule differs from pending continuation and temporary-protection application; preserve source route-specific scope.
Ordinary asylum accommodation may be private/self-funded; border procedure has a separate residence/leave-permission restriction, not a universal camp detention rule.
Asylum eligibility failure triggers assessment of subsidiary protection, not automatic subsidiary grant or automatic removal.
Unaccompanied minor representative is not an adoptive parent; source housing/food/health/school rights remain in minor context.
No FPA benefits for asylum applicants differs from reception services/allowance; never cross out people or imply no support at all.
Quota route uses UNHCR recognition/proposal and Finnish selection; no self-application or family nomination. The500quota is explicitly source year2025, not current2026.
Temporary protection: non-EU prior-Ukrainian-protection OR permanent-residence route retains inability-to-return condition; family link predates24.2.2022.
Temporary-protection work/study right starts immediately after application; municipal employment services after permit; possible FPA entitlement from work OR1yearresidence, not both required.
review_limits: Photo requests are semantic only, unresearched. No source-law update, exact application form, extra fee, deadline, nationality route, risk map, monetary amount or guarantee added. Actual artwork,full source fidelity,translation/layout,narration and export reviews remain root responsibilities.
